ByAdam Pond

November 05, 2026

undefined mins

Aravind Srinivas, CEO and Co-founder of Perplexity. Credit: Getty

Aravind Srinivas, Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, tripled revenue in 2026 by turning his AI answer engine into Computer, an AI agent for enterprise work [...] Key facts

 Enterprise: PayPal runs 74,000 Perplexity queries a week across 3,700+ weekly users (2026)
 Cloud: a three-year US$750m Microsoft Azure agreement signed in January 2026
 Models: Computer orchestrates 19 AI models
 Users: 37.9 million monthly active app users in February 2026, up about 45% in six months

## Enterprise adoption and IPO [...] AlixPartners, Lambda, Bessemer Venture Partners and the Cleveland Cavaliers have also published results. Infrastructure has scaled with demand. AWS remains the preferred cloud provider, while a three-year US$750m Microsoft Azure agreement signed in January 2026 opened access to further frontier models through Microsoft Foundry, according to Bloomberg.

On Samsung's Galaxy S26, Perplexity sits inside Galaxy AI at system level with its own wake word.

message.content:
## Recent developments
* **Financial Milestone & Growth:** Perplexity AI's run-rate has topped US$750 million, driven by a rapid acceleration in enterprise adoption (such as PayPal running 74,000 queries a week and broad use by organizations like AlixPartners and the Cleveland Cavaliers) [AI Magazine](https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate).
* **Teammates Feature Expansion:** Perplexity launched its proactive multi-agent capability, **Teammates**, to the Mac app for Max subscribers (following web and iOS availability), allowing agents to collaborate on tasks like QA, customer service, and research [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brigns-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac).
* **Open-Weight Models Release:** In mid-November 2026, Perplexity released open weights for `pplx-decider-v1.3` and `pplx-decider-flash-v1.3` under the Apache 2.0 license on Hugging Face, introducing specialized decision and text-span extraction classifiers built on Qwen architectures [CASRAI](https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026).
* **Legal Challenges:** A class-action lawsuit was filed against Perplexity AI in a California federal court, alleging that the company misled consumers regarding undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features [Top Class Actions](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features).

## Talking points
* **Enterprise Scaling & Security:** Discuss how Perplexity is managing enterprise infrastructure, security requirements, and major cloud agreements (including AWS and its Microsoft Azure partnership) to support rapid corporate scaling.
* **Agentic Ecosystem (`Teammates` & `Computer`):** Explore the transition from a traditional query-based search engine to an agentic workspace where multi-model orchestrations handle end-to-end workflows.
* **Open-Source Strategy:** Discuss the strategic value behind releasing open-weight routing and decision models like the `pplx-decider-v1.3` family to the developer community.

## Open questions
* How is Perplexity addressing the recent legal scrutiny concerning transparent usage limits on paid subscriptions?
* What are the monetization and adoption metrics for advanced tiers like Perplexity Max and the new Mac "Teammates" feature?
* How does Perplexity plan to manage compute costs and model orchestration overhead as enterprise query volume scales past the current US$750m run-rate?

## Sources
* [CASRAI: Perplexity Releases Open-Weight Decider v1.3 and Flash Decision Models](https://casrai.org/news/perplexity-pplx-decider-v1-3-open-weights-release-2026)
* [AI Magazine: Perplexity: AI Answer Engine Tops US$750m Run-Rate](https://aimagazine.com/news/perplexity-ai-answer-engine-tops-us-750m-run-rate)
* [Top Class Actions: Perplexity AI sued over undisclosed usage caps on paid subscription features](https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/lawsuit-news/perplexity-ai-sued-over-undisclosed-usage-caps-on-paid-subscription-features)
* [9to5Mac: Perplexity brings AI agents feature called Teammates to the Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/13/perplexity-brigns-ai-agents-feature-called-teammates-to-the-mac)
